# Psalm 103 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

## 103:3 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** The-one-forgiving all your-iniquity, the-one-healing all your-diseases,
- **LOGOS:** who forgives all your iniquity, who heals all your diseases,
- **PNEUMA:** He forgives every sin. He heals every disease.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 103:10 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** Not according-to our-sins he-has-done to-us, and-not according-to our-iniquities he-has-repaid to-us.

- **PNEUMA:** He doesn't treat us the way our sins deserve; he doesn't pay us back for what we've done wrong.
